scope: Pressure panel only after both analysis manifest and true-family summary existed; readonly interpretation, no native calls, no parameter/model changes, no DR intervention.

timing.boundary: logical costs charge common once to every method; physical counts each common once; generation/manager overhead separate

status_and_timing.scope: fresh simulated single days; no DR executed; conditional pair is finite-library diagnostic, not calibrated confidence

bootstrap.unit: network/day; paired profile/level siblings stay together
bootstrap.strata: four fixed networks, five day replicates each
bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive 95 percent intervals; case-specific factor cells have only five day replicates
bootstrap.draw_schedule: independent case-major vectorized resamples; the published overall cluster_intervals.csv uses a different draw schedule, so small Monte Carlo endpoint differences are expected
bootstrap.overall_reporting_rule: Use official_overall_cluster_intervals for published overall effects; independent intervals support factor/level/case descriptions

limits: Pressure contains four planned versions, not a complete eight-cell factorial.

The true support family is charged its raw stored count in oracle J even when fitted weights collapse; 21 pressure inputs exhibit such collapse, so raw and contracted physical representations must be distinguished.
All physical response-bound diagnostics remain within [0,2]; recovery loss is not explained by a declared true coefficient beyond the common response box.

Rank can remain full despite weak independent excitation. Conditioning and oracle zero weights are evidence of difficulty under this finite noisy model, not an information-theoretic impossibility proof.
Noise and AC-to-linear bias are not separated by these conditions or loss decompositions.
The pressure trajectories are new seeds; its means must not be treated as paired differences from the main panel.
Truth availability in a returned pair is only an upper bound on binary DR recovery; no DR measurements were collected.
